items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: He had played with Claude Thornhill and everybody else and he was scared to play with Bob Crossford's band.

ctx.x: And I went with Fazola the first session he made with Bob Crosby. I went with him and he was nervous. He was shaking like a leaf. He said, come with me Bill. He says, man I'm scared. I said you're scared to play with those fellas. I said you should know those fellas better than anybody else. I mean, from your own hometown. He had played with Claude Thornhill and everybody else and he was scared to play with Bob Crossford's band. So they were stuck for something to play and I suggested that the March of the…
And that was his first session with the Bob Crossford band.
